notesDetails.title: Upfront OTP 28 Source Audit in Preparation: Rejecting :httpc Retry Queues & Solving Boot-Window Ctrl-C via SIGUSR2
bullets: Inspecting OTP `inets` Before Writing S3 (Turns 11–15, Lines 54–68): During `Preparation`, the agent read `/nix/store/.../inets-9.6.2.4/src/http_client/httpc_handler.erl` and confirmed `clobber_and_retry/1` and `retry_pipeline/2` automatically re-dispatch requests on dropped keep-alive sockets. Rejecting `:httpc` upfront saved any S3/S4 rework: it built a zero-dependency 540-line `CapyBench.HTTPClient` on `:gen_tcp` and `:ssl` with `:verify_peer`, `:public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)`, IP-literal SNI suppression, 16 KiB streaming `Content-Length`/`chunked`/EOF discard, and monitored-worker 2,000 ms deadline cancellation.

Race-Free `SIGUSR2` + `SIG_IGN` Boot Bridge in `./cb` (Turns 33–46, Lines 126–181): When its first S1 PTY probe using `SIGUSR1` triggered OTP's default `erl_signal_handler` crash dump (`Received SIGUSR1 / Crash dump is being written to: erl_crash.dump`, Line 139), the agent switched `./cb` to forward `SIGUSR2` instead. To close both POSIX shell races, `./cb` launches `( trap '' USR2; exec escript "$escript_path" "$@" ) <&0 &` (so `SIG_IGN` protects the BEAM VM during early boot until `CapyBench.SignalHandler.install/1` calls `:os.set_signal(:sigusr2, :handle)`), repeats `kill -USR2` every 50 ms until child exit, and loops `wait "$child"` whenever `trap_fired=1` so the PTY stays open for the S7 partial summary.

Proactive `:logger` `stderr` Rebinding Before S3 (Turn 94, Line 339): Before writing TLS tests, the agent probed `:logger.update_handler_config(:default, :config, %{type: :standard_error})`, caught `{:illegal_config_change, :logger_std_h, ...}`, and implemented `route_logger_to_stderr/0` in `CapyBench.CLI.main/1` by removing and re-adding `:default`—preventing OTP TLS handshake alerts from ever polluting `stdout`.

notesDetails.title: Strict Red-Green TDD Discipline & Hashline Edit Guardrails (18 Intentional Failing Test Runs Out of 38 Tool Errors)
bullets: 18 Deliberate Red-Phase `mix test` Runs: Out of 33 non-zero `bash` exits across 91 shell calls, 18 were intentional red-phase test runs verifying each new acceptance or unit test failed before writing implementation code (`S1` Lines 103 & 119; `S2` Lines 202, 226, 241, 253, 268, 283; `S3` Lines 359, 390, 411; `S4` Lines 512, 538; `S5` Lines 576, 588; `S6` Lines 612, 621; `S7` Line 684). The remaining 15 `bash` errors were Turn 1's missing-`.git` check (`1`), disposable Python PTY/OTP probes (`6`), `--warnings-as-errors` compile checks (`3`), one S3 `mix credo --strict` refactoring catch (`1`, Line 480), and `4` quick test adjustments.

5 Hashline `edit` Guardrail Catches (92.8% Edit Success): Across 69 `edit` calls and 21 `write` calls, `omp`'s hashline editor rejected 5 edits before touching disk—1 single-line `PUT 13*:` block anchor (Line 130), 1 range-boundary check on `cb` (Line 147), and 3 unseen-line anchor checks on ranged file reads (Lines 454, 465, 630) whose inline line previews allowed immediate retry on the next turn without re-reading.

28 Parallel Multi-Tool Turns: Unlike strictly sequential harnesses, the agent batched up to 6 parallel tool calls in a single turn (253 tool executions across 214 LLM turns, averaging 1.18 tools/turn), clustering parallel `read` and `edit`/`write` batches at slice transitions.

notesDetails.title: Two Mid-S3 Prefix Cache Evictions Added $0.56 & Wall-Clock Was 88.3% LLM Inference vs. 11.7% Async Test Execution
bullets: Unit Economics & $50.22 Prefix Cache Savings: Across 214 turns, `gemini-4-carbon` processed `27,320,835` prompt tokens (`889,963` uncached at `$2.00/1M` = `$1.7799` + `26,430,872` cached at `$0.10/1M` = `$2.6431`; `96.74%` cache hit rate) and `148,463` output tokens including `76,349` reasoning tokens at `$10.00/1M` (`$1.4846`), totaling `27,469,298` tokens and `$5.9076` (`$5.91`, or `$11.82` under the Dec 2026 / 2027 `$4.00/$0.20/$20.00` rate schedule). Without the 95% cache discount, the run would have cost `$56.13` (`89.5%` saved).

Four Cache-Miss Turns Explained 35.9% of Uncached Input (`$0.61`): While 209 of 213 post-initial turns hit the prefix cache cleanly as context grew from `6,339` to `249,642` prompt tokens (`23.81%` of `1,048,576`, 0 compactions), `cacheRead` dropped to `0` four times—twice during early `Preparation` (Turns 5 & 7: `11,116` and `14,140` tokens) and twice mid-`S3` (Turns 125 & 127, Lines 436 & 442: `144,331` and `149,849` tokens), adding `$0.5589` in S3 alone and making S3 the peak cost slice (`$1.96` / `33.2%` of run cost).

88.3% Inference vs. 11.7% Tool Wall-Clock Split: LLM generation accounted for `55m 57.0s` (`3,357.0s`, avg `15.69s/turn`, avg TTFT `11.68s`, peaking at `89.6s` and `7,347` reasoning tokens on Turn 21), while all 253 tool calls and harness overhead took just `7m 26.6s` (`446.6s`) because every ExUnit module ran `async: true` (`39.7s async, 0.00s sync`) and intermediate slice iterations targeted individual test files.
